symmetric_transmission.description: Fix the flow capacity of two `transmission` technologies representing the same link in the system.

equations.expression: sum(where(flow_cap, map_dim(nodes, link_from)), over=nodes) == sum(where(flow_cap, map_dim(nodes, link_to)), over=nodes)

base_tech.description: Should be the name of one of the abstract base classes, from which some initial parameter defaults will be derived and with which certain base math will be triggered.
base_tech.title: Abstract base technology name.

link_from.description: Defines one end of a transmission technology.
link_from.title: The node a transmission technology links from.

link_to.description: Defines one end of a transmission technology.
link_to.title: The node a transmission technology links to.

flow_cap.description: A technology's flow capacity, also known as its nominal or nameplate capacity.
flow_cap.title: Technology flow (a.k.a. nominal) capacity
